# OpenSourceOM

> Self-hosted, Apache-2.0 cloud security graph. Collectors inventory AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes. Named queries and CSPM rules rank what an outsider can reach.

OpenSourceOM is the project behind https://opensourceom.org. The product code is https://github.com/OpenSourceOM/core. These docs are the citable description of what the software does today.

## Docs

- [Open-source cloud security docs](https://opensourceom.org/docs/): map of the documentation.
- [Install a self-hosted security graph](https://opensourceom.org/docs/getting-started/): Docker Compose, om migrate, and om scan demo.
- [Configure OpenSourceOM](https://opensourceom.org/docs/configuration/): environment variables for the CLI and API.
- [How OpenSourceOM stores the security graph](https://opensourceom.org/docs/the-graph/): nodes, edges, and how findings attach.
- [Security graph schema](https://opensourceom.org/docs/schema/): node types, edge types, and ID format.
- [OpenSourceOM attack path queries](https://opensourceom.org/docs/attack-paths/): the five named path queries.
- [OpenSourceOM identity blast radius](https://opensourceom.org/docs/blast-radius/): resources reachable from one identity.
- [Prioritize cloud risk by attack path](https://opensourceom.org/docs/prioritization/): score boosts for exposure and paths to data.
- [OpenSourceOM CLI](https://opensourceom.org/docs/cli/): om command reference.
- [Security graph REST API](https://opensourceom.org/docs/api/): HTTP routes under /v1.
- [Security graph console](https://opensourceom.org/docs/console/): the embedded graph explorer.
- [Open-source CSPM rules](https://opensourceom.org/docs/rules/): built-in checks and how findings are stored.
- [CSPM rule packs](https://opensourceom.org/docs/rule-packs/): YAML packs compiled into the binary.
- [CVE enrichment for cloud workloads](https://opensourceom.org/docs/enrichment/): NVD lookup and exposure findings.
- [Export cloud security findings](https://opensourceom.org/docs/exports/): SIEM JSONL, Slack, and Jira.
- [Cloud security collectors](https://opensourceom.org/docs/collectors/): what a scan writes, and what it does not.
- [AWS security collector](https://opensourceom.org/docs/collectors/aws/): EC2, IAM, S3, and the edges they produce.
- [Azure security collector](https://opensourceom.org/docs/collectors/azure/): VMs, storage, and role assignments.
- [GCP security collector](https://opensourceom.org/docs/collectors/gcp/): GCE, GCS, and service accounts.
- [Kubernetes security collector](https://opensourceom.org/docs/collectors/kubernetes/): pods, Services, and service accounts.
- [Custom security graph collectors](https://opensourceom.org/docs/collectors/plugins/): external collectors via om scan plugin.
- [OpenSourceOM component layout](https://opensourceom.org/docs/architecture/): collectors, Postgres, API, and exports.
- [Run OpenSourceOM with Docker Compose](https://opensourceom.org/docs/docker/): local Postgres and API.
- [Install OpenSourceOM on Kubernetes](https://opensourceom.org/docs/kubernetes/): Helm chart.
- [OpenSourceOM security model](https://opensourceom.org/docs/security/): API secret, private reads, vulnerability reports.
- [Open-source CSPM scope](https://opensourceom.org/docs/open-source/): what is in the Apache-2.0 core.
